acceptance_predicates.description: Git and SQLite phase effects use the same identity-bound operation and evidence contract.
Injected failures and process death produce durable, truthful journal outcomes and safe recovery decisions.
Stale identity or ambiguous external results never become false success or unverified mutation.
Exact-head review, hosted checks, post-merge checks, and state reconciliation pass.

definition_of_done: Concrete Git and SQLite phase capabilities are bound only from an admitted LiveUpgradeBinding.
Injected failure and process-death recovery evidence passes for both backends.
Public mutation remains fail-closed if any required phase capability is absent or ambiguous.
No handler can override backend evidence.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorized prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: AR-0107 production phase-capability factory and UpgradeEngine binding.
Existing concrete Git and SQLite authority adapters and mutation seams.

outputs.description: Concrete phase effects, parity fixtures, and durable failure/process-death recovery tests.

gates.description: All effects retain admitted project, revision, fence, barrier, and backend identity.
Failure and process-death outcomes are durable and truthful.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head and hosted result.
